rationale: Moves the editor data plane out of core/view into a new UI-free Pulp module, core/dataplane (pulp::dataplane and pulp::dataplane-audio, namespace pulp::dataplane), so the editor-host contract's VisualPort and ParamPort can be backed by it with no UI library linked. value_source.hpp keeps its path as a forwarding header: it includes <pulp/dataplane/value_source.hpp> and brings each name into pulp::view with a using-declaration, so view code and widgets compile unchanged. This is a deliberate move out of the exported set, not generic UI work: the next re-export shrinks the unit set instead of carrying the forwarder, and Vellum binds its widgets to its own generic value model rather than to Pulp's data plane.
